title: Just Enough Glass (JEG)
description: Adds more glass content to Minecraft - glass shards, glass slab and more!
body:
# Just Enough Glass
A simple Vanilla+ mod that adds more glass content to Minecraft.

## Features
- **Glass Shards** - drop when breaking glass or glass pane
- **Glass Slab** - a new decorative block made from glass
- **Crafting Recipes** - craft glass from shards and vice versa
- **Blast Furnace** - smelt sand and quartz into glass faster

## Recipes
- 4 glass shards → 1 glass block (in inventory)
- 3 glass shards → 1 glass pane
- 1 glass block → 4 glass shards
- 3 glass blocks → 6 glass slabs
- Sand / Quartz / Quartz Block → Glass (blast furnace)

## Links
- [GitHub](https://github.com/NOIST1611/JEG) - bug reports & issues
- [Source Code](https://github.com/NOIST1611/JEG)
- [YouTube Showcase](https://youtu.be/0kUIKqfkrdI)

## Work In Progress
This mod is currently in active development. More glass content is planned for future updates including new glass types and decorative blocks.
